Give a held picture's place back only for the HDEL that took its line

Codex P on #3020: dropHeldPicture read any HDEL count, zero included, as
the right to give the folder's place back, so two callers deleting the
same picture (two erasures, or an erasure and the creator's removal)
gave it back twice. forget now answers true (this call took the line),
"gone" (already taken) or false (unconfirmed); only true gives the place
back. RED 7 checks, 1 failing; now 7/7.

commit.message:
fix(test): export MAX_WAITS_PER_RUN from the email usage page stub

Main now imports MAX_WAITS_PER_RUN from @/lib/flow-limits in
app/studio/email/page.tsx. The email-usage-page alias swaps that module
for tests/email-usage-page-world.tsx, which did not export it, so the
test bundle failed with "No matching export".

The stub now re-exports the real constant from ../lib/flow-limits (a
relative path the alias does not intercept; that module has only a type
import), so the value printed by the page is the real one. Every other
name the page imports from an aliased module was already exported.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01DKvYQbKg2K8qaCy2WHt6Aq

commit.message:
fix(proof): size and read each source through one descriptor

CodeQL js/file-system-race (high) flagged native-linked.mjs:37: the
loader hook took statSync(path).size for the source-bytes ceiling and
then read the file again by path, so the bytes checked and the bytes
read could differ. It now opens the file once, takes fstatSync(fd).size
for the ceiling before reading, reads through the same descriptor and
always closes it. The ceiling still refuses before any read.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01DKvYQbKg2K8qaCy2WHt6Aq
